biotools.summary: Cellects is an open-source software tool for automatically quantifying growth and motion in 2D image sequences, applicable to a wide range of species and experimental conditions. It provides geometrical descriptors and facilitates validation, contributing to increased reproducibility and accuracy in biological studies.
